title: libpod: report why the default OCI runtime failed to initialize
body:
Podman tries to initialize every configured OCI runtime and only logs failures at debug level. If the default runtime fails, the user just sees `default OCI runtime "crun" not found`, even though crun is installed and the real problem is, for example, a non-writable `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` (reported downstream in https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/issues/226849). This keeps the initialization errors and returns the one for the default runtime:

```
Error: default OCI runtime "crun" failed to initialize: creating OCI runtime exit files directory: mkdir /run/user/1000/libpod/tmp/exits: permission denied
```

Part of https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/571688
